'''Kodai Burkan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He collaborated with the Imperials by making deliveries between the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] and the [[Troida Military Workshop]].
